ecommerce_have_experience_with.question: Do you have experience with e-commerce SEO?
ecommerce_have_experience_with.answer: Yes. AVR Web Consulting has run SEO and AI visibility programmes for e-commerce businesses across India, the USA, UK, UAE and Europe. We work to shoppers comparing price, delivery and reviews search behaviour and a typical 1–14 days decision cycle rather than applying a generic checklist.

ecommerce_long_ecommerce_seo.question: How long does e-commerce SEO take to show results?
ecommerce_long_ecommerce_seo.answer: Technical and on-page fixes usually move impressions within 3–6 weeks. Meaningful ranking and enquiry growth typically lands in months 3–6, with compounding gains after that. Sites with existing authority move faster than new domains.

ecommerce_ecommerce_seo_cost.question: What does e-commerce SEO cost at AVR Web Consulting?
ecommerce_ecommerce_seo_cost.answer: Programmes start at $100/month for focused local or single-service work and scale with content volume, number of locations and competition. We quote after an initial audit so the scope matches the opportunity, not a template.

ecommerce_which_keywords_matter.question: Which keywords matter most for e-commerce?
ecommerce_which_keywords_matter.answer: The highest-value clusters are category and "buy <product> online" queries; "best <product> under <price>" listicle intent; brand + size / colour / spec variants. We prioritise commercial intent first, then supporting informational content that feeds both search rankings and AI answers.

ecommerce_get_ecommerce_brands.question: How do you get e-commerce brands mentioned by ChatGPT and Perplexity?
ecommerce_get_ecommerce_brands.answer: AI shopping assistants compare specs, price and return policy. Stores that publish that data in machine-readable form get shortlisted; stores that hide it in images do not.

ecommerce_structured_data_implement.question: What structured data do you implement for e-commerce?
ecommerce_structured_data_implement.answer: We deploy Product + Offer + AggregateRating + BreadcrumbList alongside sitewide Organization and BreadcrumbList markup, validated against Google's Rich Results Test and kept in sync as content changes.

ecommerce_also_handle_paid.question: Do you also handle paid ads for e-commerce clients?
ecommerce_also_handle_paid.answer: Yes. Google Ads and social advertising run alongside SEO so you have demand today while organic and AI visibility compound. Many clients start with paid for speed and shift budget to organic as rankings mature.

ecommerce_which_kpis_report.question: Which KPIs do you report for e-commerce?
ecommerce_which_kpis_report.answer: We report non-brand organic revenue, category page rankings and ctr, product rich-result coverage, ai assistant product mentions — plus AI visibility tracking that shows how often your brand appears in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.

ecommerce_work_manual_safe.question: Is the work manual and safe for e-commerce sites?
ecommerce_work_manual_safe.answer: Every link, citation and content asset is produced manually. We use no PBNs, no automated link tools and no AI-spun content — critical in a sector where thin, duplicated product descriptions across thousands of skus.

ecommerce_work_with_our.question: Can you work with our existing e-commerce website?
ecommerce_work_with_our.answer: Yes. We audit and improve what you have first — most sites gain more from fixing crawlability, structure and content depth than from a rebuild. If a rebuild genuinely pays back, our web team can handle it.
